excerpt: essence: lack of cognitive significance requires essential truths characteristic of [p], D, their plurality, or involved entities according to which ∧D → p.
overview: This principle links the epistemic absence of a live connecting question to Fine-style essence. It explains why the ground propositions imply the grounded proposition: the implication is written into the nature of the relevant facts, plurality, or entities.
title: Essence Entailment Principle
